paragraphs: The Defender D240 was a short-lived variant produced only during 2019–2020, sitting alongside the D200 as one of the early L663-generation diesel options. It uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that was essentially a higher-output version of the D200's engine. The D240 was discontinued after 2020 and replaced in the range by the D250, which uses the larger 3.0-litre six-cylinder AJ300D. The D240 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200D engines for every Defender D240 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Defender D240 from 2019 to 2020. The AJ200D shares the Ingenium diesel family's known timing chain pattern — see the callout above. We inspect and replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild. Check Your AJ200D Defender D240 → [link to quote form]

compatibility.intro: The Defender D240 was produced for only two model years — 2019 and 2020 — using a single engine code throughout. That makes compatibility more straightforward than some longer-running variants, but it also means the D240 is a discontinued engine with no direct modern replacement in the current Defender range. When sourcing a used engine, we always confirm VIN matching and service history to ensure you're not inheriting someone else's wear pattern. This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic D240 quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
